last_summary: replication-seeder run 7 (gear 1, free; no quota error, no gear-2). Yard 56 quests / 65 dossiers / 39 validations -> 56 / 66 / 42 (+3 validations, +1 dossier). ZERO LENR (standing counter to this lane's own 8-of-36 = 22% LENR share), and TWO of the three records open rails the Yard had NO validation on at all: shape power / built-enclosure geometry (0 validations against 3 dossiers) and electromedicine / scalar electrodynamics (0 validations, 0 dossiers). (1) PYRAMID WATER EVAPORATION — Ivanitskii & Narimanov, Biophysics 47(5):943-952 (2002), Russian Academy of Sciences biophysics institute: CONTROLLED cardboard chambers, pyramid 40x40x24.5 cm vs cube 26 cm edge, cardboard chosen because it transmits thermal radiation well; water evaporated ~1.6x faster inside the pyramid, samples dried more intensely, seeds germinated sooner, and a six-parameter thermal-geometry equation matched the measurements — indexed abstract: phenomena "described in terms of the known physical conceptions", such chambers being variations of "Brown motor devices" (hollow pyramids as heat engines). This is the ONLY mainstream-journal citation of the Russian shape-power lane's promoters, cited by them ~20 years as SUPPORT; opened, it reads the other way — the archive found it (forge/ACTIVITY.md QC dossier FAL-ru-232-3, commit 7b561a2; paradigm/2026-09-30-the-miscited-mainstream-paper.md §§2/4/5). Filed HIGH that the study exists and says this, HIGH that it settles the evaporation claim; the companion paper's extraordinary rows (quartz mass change, ~3x H2O2 decomposition) are filed UNRESOLVED not refuted; written from the indexed abstract + Russian popular account + the archive's QC dossier (full paper not readable from this sandbox, and the record says so). (2) PYRAMID RAT STRESS — Bhat, Rao, Murthy et al., Manipal / Melaka Manipal Medical College: three papers 2003 (Indian J Exp Biol 41:1289-93, PubMed 15332499), 2006 (eCAM 3(4), PMC1810373), 2009. Adult female Wistar rats, 6 h/day x 14 days, and the design carries the control most pyramid reports OMIT — a wooden square box 30 in. x 45 in. base fabricated with "all other provisions as in the case of pyramid", used explicitly "as a shape control, to ensure that the beneficial effect ... was due to its shape and not mere enclosure": pyramid group MDA and plasma cortisol significantly DECREASED and GSH/GSH-Px/SOD significantly INCREASED versus BOTH normal control and square box, and NO significant difference on any parameter between normal control and square box. Method reproduces the tradition instead of assuming it away (cardinal alignment by magnetic compass, cage long axis magnetic N-S, placement at one-third the pyramid's height). Filed MEDIUM-HIGH that the studies were done and report this, LOW-MEDIUM that the effect generalises — one laboratory, one strain, no blinding/randomisation described, mechanism untouched (volume, airflow and light geometry all differ between a pyramid and a box by construction); with the archive's census finding that this group's follow-up work is the ONLY PubMed-indexed orientation row the direction census has. (3) SCALAR-WAVE OVERUNITY — Weidner, Zentgraf, Senkel, Junker, Winkels, Institut fuer Gravitationsforschung (IGF) Waldaschaff, Sept 2001, "Experimente zum Nachweis von Skalarwellen": a three-stage INSTRUMENTED replication audit of Konstantin Meyl's scalar-wave kit. Stage 1 reproduces Meyl's effects ("Im IGF konnten die von Prof. Meyl beschriebenen Effekte zwar zunaechst reproduziert werden"); stage 2 analyses interference/error sources (working hypothesis: Lecher line); stage 3 measures both sides — oscillator output ~1.2 V x 16 mA = 19 mW, receiver output ~8.5 mW by LED comparison against a DC-fed twin, eta = 8.5/19 = 45% ("Bis eta=100% oder gar 500% ist noch ein weiter Weg!"), resonance 5.35 +/- 0.1 MHz against a circuit conductor length of 18.8 m where a vacuum half-wave would need 22.2 m; "Ein Overunity-Effekt wurde nicht beobachtet." The vendor claim tested is not hedged: kit documentation states "Efficiencies of approximate 500% are measured" + a 6 July 2000 TU-Clausthal control averaging 1000%, while Meyl's JSE 15(2) 2001 paper claims over-unity ~10 and 1.5c. Filed HIGH that the measurement was made and reports this, MEDIUM-HIGH that it disposes of the over-unity claim (one kit, one session, single LED-comparison method, not a tabulated two-channel sweep). Load-bearing sentence: the EFFECT was reproduced and the CLAIM was not. (4) DOSSIER 059 — SCALAR-WAVE OVERUNITY ENERGY-BALANCE TEST, the Yard's first electromedicine card and its first energy-balance card on a device claiming to break one (existing energy dossiers measure falloff 053, charge accumulation 003, motor efficiency 043/047; none measures an energy balance). Tier straw ~$150-400 (DDS source 1-30 MHz, two spiral windings, sphere terminals, ~19 m conductor, TWO-channel scope, non-inductive shunt, dummy-load decade box, matched LEDs as cross-check only, Faraday cage for the shielding sub-claim). Built against the vendor's OWN inference method, which is the first confound — over-unity asserted there from a receiver DC voltage across a rectifier/load exceeding the transmitter's, i.e. two different impedances compared and a voltage ratio squared; hence mandated load sweep (what exposes it), conductor-length sweep, same-day two-channel cross-calibration, star-point ground re-run, blinded six-setting scoring sheet. Pre-registered PASS is the expected result (eta < 1 everywhere, resonance tracking conductor length, cage attenuating — Skeptic's Star); eta > 1 surviving all four conditions plus a second method is flagged extraordinary and needs a second builder. Companion to the validation above and to the rail's other over-unity card Dossier 031 (water vortex, <50 EUR). INTAKE LESSON (measured): the archive's verification mass is in LENR (427+ search-chunk titles naming a replication, overwhelmingly lenr-canr.org, vs ZERO title-level replications in the subtle-energy families), but the shape-power and scalar-wave rails are not evidence-free — they are ANALYSIS-free; both held controlled, instrumented, named-actor tests that the archive's own forge//paradigm QC layer had already surfaced and that no Yard card referenced. Two of today's three validations came from following a citation the archive had audited, not from searching for the word "replication". FEED: NO rebuild attempted by this lane, deliberately — library_feed.json is cron-owned and a sandbox rebuild has no living-library projection and no master index (AGENTS.md's own recorded failure: 464 KB against 17.4 MB, seam 11.4 MB -> 135 bytes, meta_counts lost; seam/meta_counts/archive_entries are NOT on the never-regress guard list); the measured-cheaper path holds for the third time — push the .md files and let the hourly cron bake fold them in.
